name: Stunt
description: 'Stunt' is 183 Wilboi in full showmanship mode. 183 Wilboi, the CWI roster artist Black co-produced alongside records like 'Full Moon,' trades introspection for impact on this one: a hype, aggressive trap record built for the moment before the night peaks. The genre is rap and hip hop at underground volume — underground hip hop with an anthemic reach, defiant and confident from the first bar. The beat is a Black co-production, lean and direct: hard-hitting drums throughout, booming 808s under the verses, crisp hi-hats cutting through in the chorus, and a bass-heavy low end engineered for rooms, not headphones. 183 Wilboi attacks the track like a headliner — rebellious and energetic, with a hook built for call-and-response and ad-libs that land like exclamation points. Under the hook, synth leads flash in the chorus while vocal chops keep the arrangement moving; layered underneath, a sub bass pulse gives the whole thing its physical weight. For fans of trap and underground hip hop, 'Stunt' recalls the loudest Rock-Rap Night sessions. It sits alongside 'Full Moon' as the other half of 183 Wilboi's range — the late-night thinker traded for the crowd commander — and it sounds like a stage test passed at full volume. As of October 2026 the record lived as a reference recording in the CWI vault rather than a commercial release, which makes it something rarer: raw proof that 183 Wilboi can carry a stage, captured before the industry caught up.
